////							 		ENGINE FEATURES 									  	////
// Parameters:                                                                              	  //
//                                                                         					      //
// [ID]int 					= The ID of the object.                                   			  //
// [TYP]int					= The type of the engine feature.									  //
//							  	0 = Graphics													  //
//							  	1 = Sound														  //
//							  	2 = AI															  //
//							  	3 = Physics														  //
// [NAME (LANG)]string 		= The name of the engine feature in the respective language.    	  //
// [DESC (LANG)]string 		= The description of the engine feature in the respective language.   //
// [DATE](MONTH) (YEAR) 	= The date when the engine feature is available.     				  //
// [RES POINTS]int			= Required research points.                 				  		  //
// [PRICE]int				= How much the enigne feature costs.                 				  //
// [DEV COSTS]int			= The development costs of the engine feature.       				  //
// [TECHLEVEL]int			= The tech level that the engine feature requires.					  //
// [PIC]string				= The filename of the image to be used as an icon.		  			  //
// [GAMEPLAY]int			= Amount of gameplay points the feature gives.                   	  //
// [GRAPHICS]int			= Amount of graphics points the feature gives.                        //
// [SOUND]int				= Amount of sound points the feature gives.                           //
// [TECH]int				= Amount of tech points the feature gives.                    		  //
//                                                                                    			  //
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
